description: A secondary/overflow hotel opening must not set the general hotel slot. Modeled on tails-of-summer, where the Overflow Hotel's 06-14 opening was picked over the main room block's 06-10.

posts.text: Wow, our main hotel block filled up fast! Good news: we've secured an Overflow Hotel across the street. Overflow bookings open June 14th at noon.

expect_absent.reason: June 14th opens the overflow hotel, a qualified sub-instance — only the main room block sets hotel dates
